adoption_note: Product remains the integrator and decides adoption or decline under factory-wide requirement 21 and records the decision; silent non-consumption is not permitted. Integration contract: results/frontier/frontier-concept-seed-recall/integration_contract_39237146851.json
claim_ceiling: No artifact may assert that a map helps a jurist, that any authority is absent from the corpus, that any frozen bar is met or moved, or that any packet is fit to serve. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and admission remains fail-closed. Concept-coverage counts are lexical coverage of a retrieved set, not a legal conclusion; a zero count is a retrieval signal, not proof of corpus absence.
continue_recommended_rationale: The charter's stop rule fires at the FIRST outcome reached and MUST NOT continue into threshold, phrasing or prompt tuning; OUTCOME_A was reached at run 39237146851 and has now been re-verified decision-byte-for-byte at run 39251875368. A further cycle under THIS charter is not specifically justified. The remaining gaps (de-kapitalverletzung coverage; eight frozen authority ids) would require new variant strings, new phrasings or a short-concept-query arm - all post-hoc tuning of a frozen rule set, out of scope by construction, and pointed at a NEW charter with its OWN frozen rules. The resume loop that keeps re-dispatching this team is not a producer-side gap: it breaks when the audit job persists a gate, integrate promotes, and the director moves portfolio .status off RUN. Another producer cycle would add verification noise, not charter progress - and the immutability guard now makes even that noise side-effect-free.

operational_failure.fix_landed_this_cycle: frontier/frontier-concept-seed-recall/immutability.py: a fail-closed, git-history-aware guard wired into harness.run(), contract.main and plan.main. Any path present in the index or in `git log --all` history is a committed historical record and its write is refused unconditionally, with the refusal naming the fresh --run-id escape hatch; untracked scratch paths stay writable so verification can run anywhere. 8 new regression tests pin the guard, including the real committed record and the re-derived original pre-clobber digest. Re-verification is now side-effect-free: freeze_ordering --no-write prints without touching the record, contract.main gained --out-dir, and harness.run refuses BEFORE any computation.
